dct_title_s: USA California Wildfires: Damage Proxy Maps, Jan 2025
dct_description_sm: # USA California Wildfires: Damage Proxy Maps, Jan 2025 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage proxy maps for USA California Wildfires (Jan 2025) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: California, USA, Eaton Fire, 19 Jan 2025, v0.9 ** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: California, USA, Wildfires, 9 Jan 2025, v2.5 ** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: California, USA, Wildfires, 9 Jan 2025, v0.9 ** (superseded) **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:** **Legal Disclaimer:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Original data ALOS-2 PALSAR-2 Product - JAXA (2023-2025)
